ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: an absent projection result is POLICY_DENIED: errors must not disclose existence (NFR-006, Register :50)
a quarantined projection is PROJECTION_NOT_READY with the served watermark (LLD v1.1 :350)
a call above the cost budget of its contract is POLICY_DENIED before the read (LLD v1.1 :120 fixes no code)
a context policy effect other than PERMIT (PERMIT_WITH_CONSTRAINTS, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, OBLIGATE) is POLICY_DENIED for reads: the gateway enforces no obligation

an absent or empty governed-context field on the wire is POLICY_DENIED (ADD v1.3 :380); a malformed wire digest is SCHEMA_VIOLATION (PO NCR-C2-008 option 2); a principal or actor_chain in the body is SCHEMA_VIOLATION (closed QueryContext)

the served context of an error carries the request classification_marking_ref as result_marking_ref and the content address of the served observation as provenance_ref (both mandatory in the contract ServedContext)
GetProvenance (no contract call in ProvenanceRequest) is served by the provenance contract registered in the active release; without one it is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY
redaction_count counts distinct withheld resources (objects, links, graph targets)
EXACT_AT_COMMIT waits within wait_timeout_ms while the projection is behind; once overtaken it answers PROJECTION_NOT_READY immediately
a code outside the closed enum raised by a sealed spike adapter behind ProjectionReadPort is answered POLICY_DENIED
a transport-stage rejection is audited with the authenticated principal; an absent correlation id is recorded as 'unparsed-request'
